registryBasis: Local registry/cadastre evidence is present: the municipal procedures portal identifies Dirección de Catastro for Alta catastral and assigns cadastral keys; the municipal IMIP service catalog offers cartography and editable SHP urban-trace plans; the state ICRES​​ON page identifies a Nogales registry office. This is local service evidence, not merely general national-agency prose.

officialSources.observation: Municipal Alta catastral procedure identifies Dirección de Catastro, requires a georeferenced plan and property documentation, and gives the municipal cadastral office contact/location.
officialSources.scope: Municipal cadastral procedure; not an anonymous parcel data API.

officialSources.observation: Municipal IMIP catalog describes current cartography, georeferencing, and editable SHP plans for the city urban trace; the offering is a request/service workflow rather than a public download endpoint.

Official 2023 cadastral-values plan is a map document from Departamento de Catastro / Ayuntamiento de Nogales Sonora and visibly contains parcel outlines and cadastral zones, but not a machine-readable parcel feature service.
State ICRES​​ON directory identifies the Nogales registry office and contact details.
officialSources.scope: State land-registry custodian directory; no parcel geometry endpoint evidenced.

requests.outcome: Official municipal homepage fetched successfully; it linked municipal departments including IMIP and Catastro-related services. No parcel API/configuration URL was present in the HTML inspected.
Indexed official procedure confirms the municipal Dirección de Catastro and cadastral workflow. Direct shell fetch later failed with DNS resolution error; no feature request was possible.
Indexed official IMIP catalog documents editable SHP/cartography services. Direct shell and web re-fetches later returned DNS/502 errors; no downloadable parcel service was obtained.

Official indexed PDF was identified as a cadastral-values map; web retrieval reported content too large and the shell route did not complete after the preceding host-resolution failure. No geometry was extracted or retained.
Indexed official state page identified the Nogales registry office, but re-fetch was denied. No parcel geometry or safe native identifier was obtained.
No ArcGIS, WMS, WMTS, GeoJSON, MapServer, FeatureServer, or public parcel endpoint was found in the fetched municipal homepage HTML.
